items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Lester, a comic, was working with the band at most theatres at that point

ctx.x: Did he have a Superman suit and the whole --

Yes, his wife -- that wife at that season or period, made the Superman suit for him and then Buddy Lester, a comic, was working with the band at most theatres at that point, and when his wife made Pete a new Superman suit which was much finer and so on, the comic wound up with the old Superman suit. He's a little guy and Pete was quite a muscular young man, and so Pete would come down
the wire and do his Superman thing, and from the other side of the stage, this little guy would come out in the baggy Superman suit. It was a funny bit. He'd play a beat-up cornet.
